copy.curiosityHook: They appear completely normal at birth, but what cold reality emerges as these strange town children begin to grow?
copy.description: After an unknown life form visits a quiet American town, the local women simultaneously fall pregnant. When the seemingly ordinary children are born, their parents gradually uncover an unsettling lack of humanity.
copy.vibeSummary: A heavy, suspenseful sci-fi horror with steady pacing, best experienced alone for maximum atmospheric tension.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by John Carpenter, this sci-fi thriller crafts an unnerving sense of domestic dread, blending eerie parental paranoia with classic alien-visitation horror.
